review_text: Good find within a stone's throw from home! A perfect place for brekky or short breaks after the uphill walk along Seminary Road in Catalunan Grande. Doughnuts are fresh though not complete with their varieties at the time we were there. Maybe it's too early and no new deliveries yet. We explored their other new offerings like the K-BUN which we love and the available Premium doughnuts like the Creme Brulee. The new coffee varieties are worth checking, too. Service staff are friendly and professional. Ambiance is good. Clean and spacious branch. We will be back for sure!
